title: Tap and Pat
lines: I am Sam. I tap the mat.
I am Pam. I pat the mat.
Sam and Pam sat. Tap and pat!

questions.listenFor: Sam. It is the first line. Point at the line and let them read it again rather than telling them.
Pam. Line three says it. A tap is one finger; a pat is a whole hand — you can show them the difference on the table.

questions.ask: Which part will you draw — Sam tapping, or Pam patting? What made you pick it?
questions.listenFor: Either one, as long as they say why. Line one is the tap; line three is the pat.
